title: The Long Uniform
author: August Okonkwo
blurb: Vesper Okonkwo, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
